title: pilosella biglana
intro: Pilosella biglana, commonly known as Rock Rose, is a perennial plant species belonging to the daisy family (Asteraceae). It is a valuable medicinal herb traditionally used to address various health concerns, including its ability to soothe and calm the nervous system, exhibiting anxiolytic and sedative properties, which contribute to improved sleep quality and reduced anxiety levels. The health benefits of Pilosella biglana include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate pain and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and other polyphenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
